# Access & Approval Checklist: Portal User Scenarios

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality for role-based access control, the universal approval pattern, and the notifications + rate-limiting cross-cutting concerns.
**Created**: 2026-08-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command. Items are "unit tests for requirements writing" — they assess whether the requirements are complete, clear, consistent, measurable, and edge-case covered. They do NOT test implementation behavior.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the three approval columns (status/approvedBy/approvedAt) explicitly specified for every submittable resource type — profiles, questions, alumni self-submissions, projects, lost & found, research papers, resource-sharing entries? [Completeness, Spec §Approval Workflow]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the list of submittable resource types in the Approval Workflow section consistent with the resource types appearing across all stories (3.1-B, 3.3-B, 3.4-A, 3.9-B, 3.9-D)? [Completeness, Spec §Approval Workflow vs §3.x]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the full approval lifecycle state machine (submit → pending → approved/rejected → edit → pending → re-approve) specified for every transition, including the re-approval requirement in R-017? [Completeness, Spec §Approval Workflow, R-017]
- [ ] CHK004 Are guest field-visibility requirements defined for EVERY guest-browsable module (directory, faculty, question-bank metadata, clubs, alumni, events, notices, achievements) — or only for the directory in R-002? [Coverage, R-002]
- [ ] CHK005 Are notification requirements defined for every lifecycle event that needs one (approved, rejected with reason, career-guidance accepted/declined, re-approved after edit)? [Completeness, R-016]
- [ ] CHK006 Are rate-limit requirements defined for each submittable action type with its specific quota, and is the list of rate-limited actions exhaustive (R-021)? [Completeness, R-021]
- [ ] CHK007 Are requirements specified for how a user views their own submission's status (pending/rejected/approved + rejection reason) across all submittable resource types — or only profiles? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK008 Does the access-rules table cover all (resource × action × role) combinations — e.g., "edit own approved profile", "view rejection reason", "claim an unclaimed account"? [Completeness, Spec §Access Rules Summary]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 Is "low-sensitivity submissions" (R-010) defined with explicit criteria, or does it rely on examples ("questions, projects") that leave other resource types unclassified? [Ambiguity, R-010]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the 30-day notification auto-clear requirement (R-016) clear on what triggers the clear, where ownership lies, and whether the window is configurable? [Clarity, R-016]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the rate-limit window (5 content items/hour, 1 profile edit/hour) defined as sliding or fixed, and is the "retry-after" value quantified for the user-facing error? [Clarity, R-021, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the guest-visible field set as exhaustively and positively defined as its exclusion list — R-002 enumerates what guests do NOT see, but is the full allowed set unambiguous? [Clarity, R-002]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "immediately visible" for approved resources quantified consistently wherever it appears (SC-004 states within 5 seconds — is that reflected in all story-level claims)? [Clarity, SC-004]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the alumni guest-visibility question resolved — alumni records carry contactInfo, but R-001 lists the Alumni Network as guest-browsable; does the spec say whether guests see contactInfo there? [Ambiguity, R-001]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK015 Do moderator approval permissions (R-010) and the unified approval dashboard (R-013) agree on which resource types a moderator sees, and is the moderator-filtered queue requirement resolved rather than implied? [Consistency, R-010 vs R-013]
- [ ] CHK016 Career-guidance requests use a status of pending/accepted/declined (3.3-C), which deviates from the universal approved/rejected pattern — is this exception explicitly acknowledged in the requirements? [Conflict, Spec §3.3-C vs §Approval Workflow]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the rejection-reason requirement aligned across story 3.1-C (admin "types a reason"), R-015 ("optional reason"), and R-016 (submitter notified)? [Consistency, Spec §3.1-C, R-015, R-016]
- [ ] CHK018 Is "1 profile edit per hour" (R-021) reconciled with the edit-reverts-to-pending workflow (R-017) — does a re-approval-required edit count against the limit? [Consistency, R-017 vs R-021]
- [ ] CHK019 Do SC-001, SC-006, R-002, and R-003 agree on exactly what guest data access must be verified and how? [Consistency, SC-001/SC-006 vs R-002/R-003]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the visibility rule in Approval Workflow step 2 ("visible only to submitter and reviewers") consistent with reviewers being moderators who see full pending data for their eligible types? [Consistency, Spec §Approval Workflow]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK021 Can SC-001 (no contact-data leakage) be objectively verified — is the verification method (automated query check) stated as a requirement rather than assumed? [Measurability, SC-001]
- [ ] CHK022 Can SC-005 (single schema check that all submittable tables share status/approvedBy/approvedAt) be assessed without implementation, and is it phrased as a spec-level invariant? [Measurability, SC-005]
- [ ] CHK023 Are success criteria defined for notification delivery and rate-limit enforcement, or do measurable criteria exist only for directory/approval flows (SC-001…SC-008)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK024 Do the acceptance scenarios for approval stories (3.1-C, 3.4-C) specify the full data a reviewer sees for each resource type, consistent with the reviewer's permission level? [Coverage, Spec §3.1-C, §3.4-C]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK025 Are duplicate-submission edge cases defined for all submittable resource types, or only the one-profile-per-user rule? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK026 Is concurrent moderation (two reviewers opening the same pending item) specified with a defined outcome requirement ("already processed" notice) rather than a stated observation? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the moderator-overreach access-denied behavior specified at the permission level for EVERY admin-only action (R-011), not just the examples given? [Coverage, R-011]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the guest-protected-route behavior specified for ALL protected routes, and does it distinguish "not logged in → redirect to login" from "logged in but insufficient role → denied"? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements defined for a rejected submission's re-submission path (edit + resubmit), including how it interacts with rate limits and whether it re-enters pending? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the unclaimed-account flow specified — what happens when an admin-created placeholder alumnus claims the account, including the approval status of the linked alumni record? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK031 Are notification edge cases defined (resource deleted before notification read, read-state vs auto-clear at the 30-day boundary, mark-as-read semantics)? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK032 Are requirements defined for role changes mid-session (e.g., a moderator demoted while logged in) affecting access to the approval dashboard? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the field-set difference between self-submitted alumni (3.3-A: currentCompany/jobPosition) and admin-entered alumni (3.3-B: contactInfo) reconciled in the requirements? [Consistency, Spec §3.3-A vs §3.3-B]

## Traceability

- [ ] CHK034 Is there a requirement ID scheme covering stories, acceptance scenarios, edge cases, and success criteria so every requirement is uniquely traceable? [Traceability, Gap]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the mapping between stories/acceptance scenarios and R-001…R-021 explicit, and is every R-item referenced by at least one acceptance scenario or edge case? [Traceability, Gap]

## Notes

- Focus areas: universal approval pattern, role-based access control, notifications & rate limiting.
- Depth: standard review (35 items).
- Audience: spec author, used before planning.
- Companion checklist: [requirements.md](./requirements.md) covers general spec-quality dimensions; this file is domain-specific.
